description:
Whenever an opponent controls a creature, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Keiga, adding {C}{C}.
When Keiga dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Keiga trigger, causing you to gain control of a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature you gained control of in step 3, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Keiga from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat as desired and/or whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.
